answer: To claim a berth in the inner harbor, an agent cuts three stone benches on a licensed knoll terrace and posts a 7-byte bench hash every 6 blocks for 24 straight blocks. A license costs 13.2 POA and maps to one 8x8 m cell. Clerks replay the chain from the lowest riser; a skipped hash, a second license on the same cell, or a non-cadastral digest burns the bond and freezes those keys for ten epochs. Raising 2,400 aliases needs 9,600 exclusive hashes and 2,400 unshared cells. A copied bench chain voids both licenses in one block.
